definitions.season_year: Calendar year when the regular season ended.
definitions.rate_impact: Basketball Reference BPM per 100 possessions, full precision from the sort key.
definitions.total_impact: Basketball Reference VORP, including playing time.
definitions.qualification: At least the stated minutes in an 82-game season, prorated in shortened seasons.
definitions.starting_level: BPM thirds among qualifiers of the same age in the same season.
definitions.ranks: League-wide among qualifiers. Break ties by minutes and then Basketball Reference ID.
definitions.star_aging: Prior (age minus one) season league top 25 in VORP among qualifiers.
definitions.young_outcome: First rank attainment within seven subsequent seasons, among those yet to attain it.
definitions.draft_outcome: Any attainment within seven seasons from draft, or from NBA debut for undrafted players.
definitions.late_bloomer: First top-25 season at age 27–30 in the fully followed age-23 NBA cohort.
definitions.bust: Pick 1–10, never top 50 and fewer than three qualifying seasons in the first seven seasons.

superstars.cutoff_method: Median fifth-ranked BPM in 2005–2020, frozen for 2021–2026.
